reason: The C# socket parses each message with JsonNode's default depth of 64, so a push holding a context at the limit fails the socket and is never applied.
The C# transport parses each answer with JsonNode's default depth of 64, so an answer holding a context at the limit fails as TRANSPORT_ERROR.
The C# socket fails on a push whose context nests deeper than a stored snapshot may, and does not read the instance again.
